name: Lightning Strikes (1-2)
source: Pathfinder Society Quest #22: Friends in Need
description: The air grows thick as the Planes of Metal and Air both bleed into the swamp once again. A small fissure opens, causing static electricity to build and, fueled by the increased presence of metal in the area, sparks begin to fly. Electrical discharges begin to break out reaching from objects to unlucky creatures.
disable: type:arcana,nature,thievery|dc:15 (trained) two times to counter the planar energies.
routine: (3 actions) On its turn each round, the electrical discharge randomly targets two creatures dealing 2d4 Electricity Damage damage. A targeted creature must attempt a type:reflex|dc:15|basic save.

offensiveAbilities.name: Bolt from the Blue!
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A non-elemental creature approaches within 20 feet;

Effect A bolt of electricity targets the creature for 2d4 Electricity Damage damage with a Basic DC 15 Reflex Saving Throw save. The hazard then rolls initiative.
